name: Moldova vignette (vinieta), trucks not registered in Moldova
law: Codul fiscal, Titlul IX (taxele rutiere), Anexa nr. 2, item 4: the charge for using Moldova's roads by vehicles not registered in Moldova, trucks and road tractors by total mass: over 3.5 t up to 10 t EUR 8 a day (32 for 7 days, 640 for 12 months), over 10 t up to 40 t EUR 11 a day (55 for 7 days, 1120 for 12 months). The table keeps the 1-day amount; trucks registered in Moldova pay instead a yearly road fee, not modelled. The page gives no date: valid_from is the day it was first read.
